page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.4xlarge is a memory-optimized instance powered by KVM hypervisor technology and x86_64 architecture. The server features 16 dedicated vCPUs driven by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at a base clock speed of 2.5 GHz. It includes 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a high ratio of 8.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance architecture omits local NVMe SSD storage and dedicated GPU hardware accelerators, relying entirely on remote cloud storage options for persistence. Network infrastructure supports a baseline network bandwidth of 5 Gbps, with zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses assigned by default.

The high memory-to-vCPU allocation makes the ecs.r6.4xlarge cost-efficient for workloads requiring high RAM capacity without needing excessive CPU compute power. Primary workload fits include in-memory databases, enterprise resource planning applications, high-density caching layers, and real-time data processing tasks.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.4xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via a KVM hypervisor. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, it supplies 16 dedicated vCPUs along with 128.0 GB of RAM, yielding an 8.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. The instance does not include bundled local disk storage or dedicated GPU accelerators, requiring external block storage for data persistence. Network performance is defined by a 5 Gbps baseline bandwidth, with no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. The high memory density provides qualitative cost efficiency for memory-intensive enterprise workloads that do not demand extensive CPU scaling. Suitable application domains include in-memory data stores, transactional databases, large-scale caching systems, and enterprise application backends.
